user.title: Connect to OTE Modbus Gateway
user.description: Enter the network address of your RS485-to-Ethernet gateway (e.g. Waveshare RS232/485/422 TO POE ETH (B)) and the Modbus address of your Ochsner OTE Modbus Gateway (TEM ZIF180), as set via its DIP switches. The cooling/auxiliary-heater options below control which sensors get created - leave them off if unsure, those registers have not been verified against real hardware yet.

data.has_cooling: System has an active cooling function
data.has_auxiliary_heater: System has an Ochsner-controlled auxiliary heater ("Zusatzheizung")
data.configure_external_sensors: Set up more accurate heat pump efficiency figures (optional, via an external electricity meter such as a Shelly 3EM)

external_sensors.title: External electricity sensors
external_sensors.description: Ochsner itself usually doesn't provide usable values for this. If a known meter device was found in your Home Assistant installation, pick it here - the efficiency sensors (lifetime efficiency/SPF and computed real-time COP) then get fed from it automatically. If nothing was found (or your device isn't supported yet, see README "Compatible meters"), use the "Manual configuration" section below instead.

manual_sensors.name: Manual configuration
manual_sensors.description: Only needed if nothing suitable was found above, or you'd rather pick specific entities yourself: up to three electricity meter sensors (kWh, for lifetime efficiency/SPF) and up to three power sensors (W, for the computed real-time COP). Read the README before wiring up new metering hardware (risk of death when working in the fuse box - only a qualified electrician should do this).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or no valid response from the gateway. Check host/port/address and that the RS485 gateway is set to "Modbus TCP to RTU" mode.
error.meter_not_recognized: This device could no longer be found or recognized. Please fill in the 6 electricity/power sensor fields manually instead, or leave this field empty.

heating_capacity.name: Heating capacity, Ochsner register (raw, undocumented unit)

lifetime_efficiency_jaz.name: Efficiency since first measurement (seasonal performance factor/SPF)
